SEVENTEEN: Tiny Desk Concert TL;DR


SEVENTEEN—13 members, three teams, one powerhouse group—made history as the first K-pop act at NPR’s Tiny Desk. Fresh off their 10th-anniversary world tour, five members (Dino, Seungkwan, Joshua, Vernon and Mingyu) traded massive stadiums for what might be their smallest stage yet, serving up a fun, laid-back medley of old and new tracks—“Super,” “HOT,” “SOS” and more—wrapped up with fan favorite “VERY NICE.”
When DK lost his voice days before, the remaining members scrambled to learn and flawlessly deliver his parts, reworking arrangements on the fly. The result? An intimate, energetic set that proves even in a stripped-down space, SEVENTEEN’s teamwork and showmanship still light up the room.
